papers.title: Tool Learning with Foundation Models
papers.authors: Yujia Qin, Shengding Hu, Yankai Lin, ... Maosong Sun (41 authors)
papers.abstract: Humans possess an extraordinary ability to create and utilize tools... We present a systematic investigation of tool learning with foundation models: from understanding the user instruction, models decompose a complex task into subtasks, adjust their plan through reasoning, and conquer each sub-task by selecting appropriate tools. We experiment with 18 representative tools and show the potential of current foundation models in utilizing tools.
